display.title: Episode 191: Saved by a Miracle, Chapter 2 (Elul)
display.summary_short: An Elul show: Onkelos and the mezuzah, Shema with two sisters, the miraculous end of the story of Reb Baruch and the Alter Rebbe, and achdus as the key to Hashem's blessings.
display.summary_long: Broadcast in Elul 5745, with Rosh Hashanah around the corner. Uncle Yossi reminds listeners that Elul is for ending the year well, then continues Mitzvah Time on the mezuzah, with a phone quiz for listeners who send in a postcard. He tells the Gemara's story of Onkelos, the convert whose translation is printed in every Chumash: the Roman soldiers sent to arrest him saw him touch the mezuzah and heard him explain that our King guards His servants from outside, and they too became Jews. After the Hakochainik march and a sponsor message, two sisters from a Brooklyn girls' school lead the Shema. Story time concludes 'Through the Eyes of a Tzaddik' (catalogued as 'Saved by a Miracle'): after waiting a week as the Alter Rebbe told him, Reb Baruch goes to the minister and learns that skipping the first appointment saved his life. Uncle Yossi then explains that achdus, unity through Torah, is the key that opens the heavenly door, and urges children to sign up friends for a letter in the children's Sefer Torah.
display.lesson: Follow the guidance of a tzaddik with full trust in Hashem, and remember that achdus through Torah is the key to Hashem's blessings.
